newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai banker Thanong is new finmin - reports.
newsitem.headline: Thai banker Thanong is new finmin - reports.

text.p: Thai Military Bank president Thanong Dhipaya is to be appointed new finance minister to replace the outgoing Amnuay Viravan, Thai newspapers reported on Friday.
The Bangkok Post, quoting informed sources, said Thanong, a low profile banker, had been offered the job by Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh and he had accepted.
The newspaper, quoting a source close to the premier, said Thanong was chosen after another leading candidate for the job, Olarn Chaiprawat, President of Siam Commercial Bank, turned the job down.

"We have to overcome time constraints since the government needs to prepare for the Budget Bill debate next week," the source said. Parliament is set to debate the budget at a special June 25-27 session.
Amnuay quit abruptly on Thursday after political differences with rivals in Chavalit's six-party coalition government. His departure caused slumps in the stocks and money markets.

The Nation newspaper quoted political observers as saying the decision to pick Thanong "confirmed speculation that top economic thinkers were distancing themselves from the government or too anxious about intense political plays to accept the big burden (of being finance minister)."
